citation.journal: Journal of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: 15 adults with stable localised lip vitiligo, followed 2 to 3 years (India)
record.design: Uncontrolled case series of medical tattooing
record.finding: Cosmetically acceptable results in all 15, with better pigmentation in darker-complexioned patients than fair ones; no allergic reactions or new patches at the tattooed site. The authors state that medical therapies for lip vitiligo are often ineffective because the lips have no hair follicles.
record.note: Tattooing adds pigment and does not restore the person's own melanocytes; permanent; no comparison group.
